options.name: action
options.description: Action while set physical drive hotspare. Required when I(option=HS). Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: duration
options.description: Duration range is 1-255, physical drive under PMC raid controller. Required when I(option=LOC). Only the M6 model supports this parameter.

options.name: encl
options.description: IsEnclAffinity while set physical drive hotspare. Required when I(option=HS) and I(action=dedicate). Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: logical_drivers
options.description: Logical Drivers while set physical drive hotspare, input multiple Logical Drivers index like 0, 1, 2..... Required when I(option=HS) and I(action=dedicate). Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: option
options.description: Set operation options for a physical disk. UG is Unconfigured Good, UB is Unconfigured Bad. OFF is offline, FAIL is Failed, RBD is Rebuild. ON is Online, JB is JBOD, ES is Drive Erase stop. EM is Drive Erase Simple, EN is Drive Erase Normal. ET is Drive Erase Through, LOC is Locate, STL is Stop Locate. HS is Hot spare. Only the M5 model supports C(HS) Settings.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: revertible
options.description: IsRevertible while set physical drive hotspare. Required when I(option=HS) and I(action=dedicate). Only the M5 model supports this parameter.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.
